items.html: Here in this place is the place of the descent and the fall of the posterior of AVI, that we said above that they descended in Atzilut itself. Even though the vessels of ZA broke, the lights of ZA remained clothed in this posterior of upper AVI, the entire line of Hesed of ZA in the posterior of Abba, and the entire line of Gevura clothed in the posterior of Ima, and study this introduction thoroughly.
